description: Binding from constituent difference using production nucleon masses (242 ppb) minus CODATA atom masses. D: +23%, T: +6%, 3He: +13%, 4He: +3.6%. Much better than sgn×f formula (70-89% off) but uses CODATA M_atom as input. For first-principles: need M_atom from framework (= knot identification problem).

data.frontier: M_atom from framework requires atom knot identification
